neighbours.label: health and fitness text about moving the body: the token just before a body part or 'physical activity' is named (bend one [knee], levels of [physical activity], poor muscle [tone]); the - pole is the slot before 'exercise(s)'
fire: Stand with your feet apart, then slowly lift one leg and hold it for ten seconds.
The study measured how many minutes of physical activity each teenager got on school days.
Sit on a firm chair and gently turn your upper body toward the window.
Children who walk to school reach higher levels of physical activity than those who are driven.
Kneel on the mat and stretch one arm forward until you feel the pull.
Older adults with low muscle strength are more likely to fall at home.
Lie face down and raise your lower legs until your heels point at the ceiling.
Wearable sensors give a reliable estimate of daily physical activity in young children.
quiet: Stand the bottle upright, then slowly pour one cup and leave it for ten seconds.
The study measured how many minutes of screen time each teenager got on school days.
Sit the patient down and gently explain the results of the blood test.
Children who eat breakfast reach higher levels of vitamin D than those who skip it.
Open the packet and take one tablet with a full glass of water.
Older adults with low blood pressure are more likely to feel dizzy at home.
Wash the wound and cover it with a clean dressing until it stops bleeding.
Home test kits give a reliable estimate of blood sugar in young children.

notes: Card: peak ' muscle' x10, then ' of', ' lower', ' one' in posture and physical-activity text; the - pole fires where 'exercise/stretching' is expected and the output direction suppresses those words. Probes were weak and mixed: 'level of physical activity' 0.36, 'bend one knee' 0.34, 'level of reading ability' 0.14, 'poor muscle tone' 0.09, 'more muscle than fat' 0.01. A guess at a context; it may well fail.
